concept: S3 Intelligent-Tiering: unknown or changing access pattern
tests: Choosing a storage class for unpredictable, changing access without per-object analysis.
expected: S3 Intelligent-Tiering — automatically moves objects between tiers based on usage, no retrieval fees. Triggers: "unpredictable", "pattern changes over time", "avoid per-object analysis", "retrieval-fee surprises".
why_not: Standard-IA and One Zone-IA charge retrieval fees and have a 30-day minimum (One Zone-IA also lacks AZ redundancy); Glacier Flexible Retrieval requires a restore taking minutes to hours.
